_comment: Collector watchlist. kalshi_series are polled open+settled each cycle; polymarket_pairs are CLOB token pairs [market_id, yes_token, no_token] added manually when a cross-venue pair is human-verified; nws_stations are keys into hyxlab.venues.nws.STATIONS. kalshi_book_series (2026-10-20 coverage expansion) are BOOKS ONLY: the stream daemon holds orderbook_delta for their open markets beside kalshi_series', and the REST collector never reads this key -- phase 1 = the top taker-dollar non-combo series on the 10-12..10-18 tape plus every daily-temperature series traded on the 10-16..10-22 tape that kalshi_series lacks. kalshi_book_shard_max = markets per books connection (placeholder until the venue's per-subscription cap is measured). kalshi_{ticker,lifecycle}_include_mve = keep KXMVE combo rows in stream_ticker/stream_lifecycle (default false).
